name: WebGL Volume Ray Casting (Slice Tiling)
aliases: Volume Ray Casting with Mosaic Texture and Post-Classification
definition: A volume rendering method adapted for WebGL that replaces native 3D volume textures with a 2D tiling map of volume slices to simulate 3D data while preserving tri-linear interpolation.
summary: WebGL Volume Ray Casting (Slice Tiling) is a direct volume rendering method that replaces 3D textures with 2D slice tiles to enable client-side rendering in browsers lacking hardware 3D texture support.
